summary: Scope tenant-bound Persona owner reads before first reflection using immutable tenant_id binding from creation

incident_context.symptom: Real operator_a owner GET 200 at 05:24 confirmed persona-79459591354fa57cecc2 (tenant-dev / research_only) had paper_ledger/runtime/capital metadata and no reflections, but anonymous GET 200 disclosed the full record at 05:29 while tampered signature received 401.
incident_context.root_cause: Existing _is_private_persona checked only reflection metadata (trade_reflections or trade_reflection_idempotency) and test fixtures preseeded reflections. Tenant-bound personas created before first reflection were misclassified as public, bypassing authentication and tenant scoping in list and get endpoints.
incident_context.resolution: Corrected _is_private_persona in services/persona/write_owner.py to check the genuine immutable tenant_id binding from creation (bool(tenant and str(tenant).strip())). Net production growth is 3 readable lines (<= 15 line limit).
